summary: The Jupyter notebooks behind the fastai deep learning book and course, teaching deep learning with fastai and PyTorch.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: fastbook holds the notebooks of the book Deep Learning for Coders with fastai and PyTorch, which also power the fast.ai online course. They introduce deep learning, the fastai library and PyTorch, chapter by chapter, from image classification onward.
sixtySeconds.problem: Deep learning can feel out of reach without a strong math background. This course teaches it hands-on, starting with working code.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Use it to learn deep learning through runnable notebooks, with Colab so you don't need your own GPU.
requirements: A Google account for Colab, or Jupyter on your own machine

overview: The README recommends reading and running the notebooks in Google Colab instead of cloning the repo.
Each chapter has a direct Colab link in the README, starting with an introduction to Jupyter.
Code in the notebooks is GPL v3; the prose is not openly licensed and may not be redistributed.
strengths: No local GPU needed with Colab
limitations: Prose can't be copied or rehosted
